data.title: Half Yearly results published
data.body: Results of the Half Yearly Examination are now available in the Parent and Student apps. Parent-teacher meeting on Saturday.

data.title: Diwali & Chhath vacation
data.body: The school will remain closed from 6 November to 12 November 2026 for Diwali and Chhath Puja. Classes resume on 13 November.

data.title: Staff meeting
data.body: All teaching staff to assemble in the conference room on Friday at 2:30 PM for the Term 2 planning meeting.

data.title: Winter uniform
data.body: Winter uniform is compulsory from 15 November. Navy blue blazer and grey trousers/skirt.
